snippet.title: Clairval - Trailer n°2
snippet.description:
Clairval: The deduction game where everyone lies.

Step into the village of Clairval, where words are your sharpest weapon… or your deadliest weakness. In a world woven by 8 central souls, each with their own agenda, can you unmask the truth before the night falls?

Manipulate, accuse, survive.
Join the Experience:

Play on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4791400/Clairval/
Website: https://clairval.net/
Join the Community: https://discord.gg/AdaSQqQKf9

Features:

- 8 Protagonists: Discover a deep, ever-evolving lore.
- 40+ Unique Roles: Master complex tactics and dynamic gameplay.
- Social Deduction: A game built on cunning, suspicion, and strategy.
- Living Community: Forge bonds in Guilds and leave your mark on the history of Clairval.

An Alpharkane Experience.
Frequent updates, community-driven development, and infinite mysteries. Will you survive the night?
